brief: 5 email tools that print revenue — from capture to nurture to conversion, with real metrics.

slots.desc1: Newsletter platform built for growth and monetization.
slots.desc2: Ecommerce email and SMS automation that drives repeat sales.
slots.desc3: Creator-first automation for segmenting and scaling audiences.
slots.desc4: AI sales email coach that doubles reply rates instantly.
slots.desc5: Outbound engine for finding leads and booking meetings fast.

slots.toolTagline: Capture once, nurture forever, and convert on autopilot.
slots.bigStatement: This 5-tool stack builds a self-funding email engine with real metrics.
slots.use1Body: Turn traffic into owned audiences with high-converting forms.
slots.use2Body: Behavioral sequences segment and educate new subscribers.
slots.use3Body: Precision timing turns inbox clicks into customers.

slots.toolTagline: The newsletter platform built for growth and monetization.
slots.bigStatement: Beehiiv turns your content into a lead magnet with built-in referral loops and zero code.
slots.use1Body: Built-in reward systems grow your list organically.
slots.use2Body: Monetize opens instantly with premium newsletter sponsors.
slots.use3Body: One-click subscribe reduces friction to almost nothing.

slots.toolTagline: Ecommerce email and SMS that prints repeat revenue.
slots.bigStatement: Klaviyo predicts customer lifetime value and triggers flows that recover carts automatically.
slots.use1Body: Recover lost revenue with hyper-personalized timing.
slots.use2Body: AI segments your best buyers before they churn.
slots.use3Body: Reach customers where their attention lives now.

slots.toolTagline: Creator automation that turns subscribers into loyal fans.
slots.bigStatement: ConvertKit lets you tag and segment by behavior so every email feels like a personal DM.
slots.use1Body: Build complex funnels with a simple drag-and-drop map.
slots.use2Body: Sell digital products directly to your email list.
slots.use3Body: Creator-optimized sending lands in primary inboxes.

slots.toolTagline: AI sales email coach that doubles your reply rates.
slots.bigStatement: Lavender scores your emails in real time and suggests fixes that book more meetings.
slots.use1Body: Instantly grade readability and personalization before sending.
slots.use2Body: Optimize every message for phone-first executives.
slots.use3Body: Pull prospect data to craft relevant openers fast.

slots.toolTagline: Outbound engine for finding leads and booking meetings fast.
slots.bigStatement: Apollo combines 275M contacts with sequencing so you can scale outreach without spamming.
slots.use1Body: Filter 275M+ contacts by title, tech stack, and intent.
slots.use2Body: Multi-channel touch cadence that feels human at scale.
slots.use3Body: Distribute sends across mailboxes to protect deliverability.

slots.body: Email isn't dead—it's the highest-ROI channel founders ignore. Start with capture, automate nurture, and convert with precision.
